plan.title: SRC-STR-009 Dynamic extension across buyer and vendors

steps.note: Reach the single-stage auction configuration.
Enable the required event-creation configuration.
Allow participants to be added before publishing.
Configure a two-minute extension for a qualifying late price change.
Give the test event a unique title.
Apply a reverse-auction pricing template.
Add the requested product and quantity.
Complete required buyer-side sheet fields.
Select the requested delivery location.
Verify the requested location was accepted.
Invite three QA participants representing Vendors A, B and C without inventing company names.
Commit the requested 30-minute bidding window.
Publish the configured auction.
Confirm the auction reached a real project page.
Establish Vendor A's initial bid using the default price so Vendor B's 95 improves the leader.
Confirm the initial bid was accepted.
Open Vendor B's separate supplier session.
Prepare Vendor B's auction bid sheet before waiting.
Wait until one minute remains and record the original end time.
Submit Vendor B's qualifying bid inside the two-minute trigger window.
Confirm the late bid was accepted.
Verify Vendor B sees an end exactly two minutes later.
Return to Vendor A's session.
Reload the auction for the existing bidder.
Verify Vendor A also sees the two-minute extension.
Check the remaining invited participant's view.
Open the auction as Vendor C.
Verify the extension also reaches a participant who has not bid.
Return to the buyer console.
Verify the buyer's Responses includes both accepted portal bids.
Verify the buyer reads the same two-minute end-time change.
Assert the participants panel accounts for the extension.
Open the auction's activity history.
